question: What café can I find within 70 kilometers when heading from Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ toward NYU Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.995715 40.728699)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, 70000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
